dedupe_keys.name: number of deaths and injuries from traffic accidents

description: Number of Deaths and Injuries from Traffic Accidents is a series of data sets listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by National Planning Council. This dataset contains statistical data on the number of deaths and injuries resulting from traffic accidents. The data is structured by year and categorized by the result of the accident, including deaths, severe injuries, and slight injuries. This dataset provides insights into the trends and patterns of traffic-related casualties over the years. Coverage: Qatar. The portal lists 8 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher National Planning Council. Its tags are traffic, traffic accidents, deaths, road safety. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-05-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
